tags.title: Penicillin
tags.lyrics-eng:
There’s been an infection in this class of drugs, worth the mention
Purified viruses developed

A resistance in the veins,
pumping out mild

Assistance, breathe in,
breathe out, do what I can to find out
Isolation at its finest,
causing a fever, but I’m a firm believer that it’s doing justice within my system

I’m not waking up without my penicillin I’m not going to bed without my penicillin
I’m not living life without my penicillin
Isolation at its finest,
causing a fever, but I’m a firm believer that it’s doing justice within my system

Causing a fever, but I’m a firm believer that it’s doing justice within my system

Isolation at its finest,
causing a fever, but I’m a firm believer that it’s doing justice within my system

Beep
